form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Lankford introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the Federal Reserve Act to prohibit the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System from discontinuing Federal Reserve notes if a central bank digital currency is issued, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the No Digital Dollar Act.

subsection.text: Section 16 of the Federal Reserve Act is amended by adding after the 17th undesignated paragraph (12 U.S.C. 467) the following:

paragraph.text: The Board of Governors may not discontinue issuing Federal Reserve notes if a central bank digital currency is issued.

subsection.text: Section 5112 of title 31, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following:
The Secretary of the Treasury may not discontinue minting and issuing coins under this section if a central bank digital currency is issued.
No central bank digital currency shall be considered legal tender under section 5103 of title 31, United States Code.
